title: Helpful Recipes
description: It's just a bit more than "Helpful Recipes," We have a whole new progression tree! just for you!
body:
# WELCOME TO HELPFUL RECIPES
  -# except not really, there is a LOT more...

Helpful Recipes started out as a simple mod to be able to craft the saddle and turn rotten flesh into leather (functionalities which are STILL IN THE MOD!) for an old project a friend and I were doing, but it has grown into much MUCH more!

Helpful Recipes includes a whole new progression tree just for reaching the nether(still in development,) which includes:
- Crystal Bases to make things like Amethyst, Diamonds, Emeralds, and Holomite, a new mineral.
- Machines such as the Crystalline Coagulator, Atomic Heater, and Plasmatic Heater.
- A whole new weapon called the Railgun, which carves massive trenches in the earth with an hour long cooldown for balancing.
- A structure which generates under the sea.
- The Stick of Truth which tells you if any given block is infested or not.

I have been developing this mod as a sort of continuing passion project, and will continue doing so. Feel free to leave suggestions in the Discord!

# INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS

It's pretty simple, just load this into whatever modpack you desire and make sure to include No Nether Portal!
-# a massive part of this mod's new progression tree is literally just to make it harder to reach the nether so please dont forget that part.
